name: Entrenched Fortress's On Enter deals 3 damage to target unit
notes: Entrenched Fortress is a TERA (advanced element) DOMAIN card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real TERA champion (Kongming, Fel Eidolon) to unlock element access. Like other DOMAIN cards (see stocked-outpost-enter-draw-memory), it materializes onto the field like any other permanent -- there's no separate domain zone in this schema. The target MZCHOOSE decision appears immediately after the final reserve payment with no intervening opportunity window (like dream-fairy-return-to-memory/cosmic-bolt-damage, unlike several other action cards in this batch), so no PASS actions are needed before it. Only the On Enter damage is covered; Taunt is a combat-targeting-priority passive that requires a real attack declaration and is out of scope.

rulesClauses: On Enter: Deal 3 damage to target unit.
